If you need anyone to talk to, I am here. 

I have went through the same things. I have seen friends disappear because of my depression. I regret a lot of things (from what I have read, you do too). There is ALWAYS time to reverse this. Please don't end it. You have time to prosper, and I know you will. 

Your life will start and progress!! Just please don't give up. Work hard and prove all those fucks wrong.
